title: Blockbench atlas freshness and isolated Hytale vegetation export validation
summary: Reloading an overwritten atlas by the same file path left stale foliage in Blockbench 5.2.2. Loading current bytes through fromDataURL, awaiting image load and checking embedded PNG hashes produced matching editable sources and native exports for six Hytale 0.7.2 vegetation assets. Native loading and persistence passed; client visual acceptance remains with the user.
problem_class: stale editor texture after same-path asset replacement
problem_description: The PNG on disk changed but the current and newly created Blockbench projects could still display the previous procedural foliage after fromPath. Exporting before asynchronous image loading also risked stale or incomplete embedded source textures.
context: Six original vegetation assets in the existing Zytale asset pack. Production world must remain untouched. User rejected the first conifer's visual fidelity and later explicitly took ownership of client visual review.
constraints: Do not infer visual approval or player collision behavior from server tests
Preserve existing pack namespace and prior assets

solution_versions.description: Author through the installed native Blockbench codec with freshly loaded atlas bytes, preserve editable texture embeddings, and validate pack loading and persistence in a guarded isolated world.
changes: Load PNG bytes as data URL and await image load before material update and export
Verify source embedded PNG SHA256 against the final atlas
Check UV bounds, native geometry and node budget
Run Hytale 0.7.2 create/reload in a UUID- and path-guarded test save
Keep client appearance, traversal and FPS explicitly unverified until reviewed
advantages: Editor source and runtime texture stay synchronized
Existing mod resources and production save are byte-checked
No GUI automation required for authoring or native validation
disadvantages: Editor and headless checks do not prove game-client visual quality
Branch cutout overdraw still needs client performance review
test_results: 6/6 native models pass Hytale plugin validation
6/6 source embedded images match atlas SHA256
17/17 instances persist after native restart with matching rotation
80/80 pre-existing resources and 6169/6169 production files unchanged

metrics.performance: Texture storage and geometry counts measured; FPS UNVERIFIED

transferability: Applicable to editor pipelines that cache image paths and embed asynchronously loaded images. Exact fromDataURL and texture APIs are specific to inspected Blockbench 5.2.2; retest other versions.
